name: Juuzoku no Kotodama
source:
Vigilant redhead of the high seas, Nami, is used to graduate one boy's virginity and pop her own anal cherry.

Just before she set sail for another island, a trick was learned... and a trick was turned... and Nami changed her mind.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ079788.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
警惕的公海红发女郎娜美，被用来让一个男孩的童贞结束，并戳破自己的肛门樱桃。

就在她启航前往另一个岛屿之前，她学会了一个技巧……并且一个技巧被扭转了……娜美改变了主意。
